title: The $δ$ Scuti instability strip and period-luminosity relation as seen by TESS and Gaia DR3
headline: Mapping δ Scuti Stars Across the Sky with TESS and Gaia DR3
tldr: Using TESS 10‑minute cadence data, we surveyed over 1.5 million A‑ and F‑type stars to chart the δ Scuti instability strip. Combining Gaia DR3 parallaxes and photometry, we derived precise stellar parameters and refined the period‑luminosity relation for these pulsators.
significance: This comprehensive survey provides the most complete δ Scuti catalog to date, enabling precise asteroseismic studies and improving distance estimates across the Milky Way.

title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
headline: Mapping the Landscape of Language Model Data Attribution for Reliable Evaluation
tldr: We systematically dissect how dataset properties influence data attribution algorithms for LLMs, revealing key failure modes. Our framework isolates variables, enabling precise diagnosis and guiding future benchmark design.
significance: This work provides a clear methodology to evaluate and improve data attribution in large language models.

title: Micro-Edits: Computational Support for Fine-Scale Edits in Film
headline: Fine‑Scale Film Editing Powered by AI
tldr: AI tools now enable editors to tweak individual frames and micro‑cuts with precision, improving pacing and visual focus. These systems combine large language models and diffusion techniques for real‑time, fine‑grained adjustments.
significance: They transform the editing workflow, making subtle narrative nuances easier to achieve and enhancing audience engagement.

title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
headline: Neural Thickets Reexamined: Weight Perturbations Not Needed for Task Gains
tldr: The study shows that pretrained language models can achieve task-specific performance gains without relying on random weight perturbations. Instead, perturbing a single decoder block or freezing the model yields comparable improvements, challenging the Neural Thickets hypothesis.
significance: It simplifies the understanding of how pretrained models adapt to new tasks, potentially reducing computational overhead.

title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
headline: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Efficient Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
tldr: The paper introduces a tokenization scheme that allocates global tokens for low-frequency image structure and local tokens for high-frequency detail, reducing the cost of global attention. This approach improves efficiency while preserving fine-grained image generation quality.
significance: It offers a scalable solution for high-resolution generative modeling by balancing global and local attention.

title: SwapBot: Tool-Centric Robot Manipulation via Interchangeable End-Effectors and Tactile Sensing
headline: SwapBot: Autonomous Tool Swapping with Tactile Sensing for Everyday Robot Manipulation
tldr: SwapBot enables robots to autonomously exchange interchangeable end-effectors and use tactile feedback to perform diverse household tasks. The system demonstrates forceful cutting, delicate brushing, and precise placement without human intervention.
significance: By integrating tool swapping and tactile sensing, SwapBot advances autonomous manipulation toward practical, real-world applications.

title: Adaptive Scenario Generation for KL-DRO Around a Learned Density Model
headline: Adaptive Scenario Generation Enhances KL-Divergence DRO Using Learned Density Models
tldr: This paper introduces a method for generating adaptive scenarios that tighten KL-Divergence distributionally robust optimization around a learned density model. By integrating data-driven density estimation with scenario generation, it improves solution robustness while reducing computational burden.
significance: It bridges learned probabilistic models with robust optimization, enabling more reliable decision-making under distributional uncertainty.

title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
headline: Real-World Luggage Re-Identification: Strategies for Airport, Border, and Lost Luggage Surveillance
tldr: Luggage re-identification links observations of the same bag across separate camera views, aiding security and lost luggage recovery. This study evaluates practical strategies for deployment in airports, train stations, and border crossings.
significance: Accurate luggage re-identification enhances safety and operational efficiency in high-traffic transport hubs.

title: From extreme weather to agricultural consequences with agentic AI
headline: Agentic AI Predicts Crop Damage from Extreme Weather Using Causal Weather Indices
tldr: WxCrop is an AI agent that interprets weather indices to assess agricultural hazards. By combining causal analysis with real-time weather data, it predicts which crops will be affected and the extent of damage.
significance: This tool bridges the gap between weather forecasts and actionable crop risk assessments, enabling farmers to take proactive measures.

title: SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization
headline: From a Single Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization
tldr: We propose Video-to-4DAVScene, a task that transforms a single video into an interactive, time-varying 4D audio-visual scene. Using diffusion synchronization, the method models both visual and auditory dynamics, enabling exploration of the generated scene.
significance: This work bridges the gap between visual scene generation and audio modeling, enabling richer immersive experiences from minimal input.

title: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
headline: Hexagonal Surface Elements (Hexels) Enable Low-Memory 3D Rendering and Reconstruction
tldr: Hexels are planar hexagonal primitives that encode first-order color fields, reducing memory usage for view synthesis and 3D reconstruction. They allow efficient rendering and reconstruction in resource-constrained environments by exploiting locally planar regions.
significance: Hexels provide a compact, memory-efficient alternative to radiance fields, enabling real-time rendering on limited hardware.

title: The 't Hooft model on (A)dS$_2$
headline: Solving the 't Hooft Model on (A)dS$_2$: Exact Meson Equation via SL(2,R) Casimir
tldr: We derive an exact meson spectrum for large‑N QCD on AdS$_2$ and dS$_2$ by exploiting the null gauge and the SL(2,R) Casimir. The resulting equation generalizes ’t Hooft’s flat‑space equation with a curvature‑dependent term.
significance: This work provides a rare analytic solution of non‑Abelian gauge dynamics in curved spacetime, illuminating the role of symmetry in quantum field theory.

title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
headline: ThinkWorld: Enhancing VLA Models with World Imagination for Dynamic Reasoning
tldr: ThinkWorld introduces a framework that leverages human video data to improve Vision‑Language‑Action models by incorporating world imagination and chain‑of‑dynamics reasoning. This approach balances scalable data use with explicit action grounding, boosting generalization in robotic manipulation.
significance: It bridges the gap between large‑scale visual data and actionable robot control, advancing the robustness of VLA systems.

title: Exact Analytical Treatment of Collectively Pumped Dicke Superradiance
headline: Exact Analytical Solution for Collectively Pumped Dicke Superradiance in Symmetric Spin Ensembles
tldr: We derive an exact finite continued fraction representation for the dynamics of an N‑atom Dicke system under collective decay and incoherent pumping. This analytic framework resolves the infinite quantum‑trajectory histories and provides closed‑form rate equations for the symmetric ladder.
significance: The result delivers a complete, computationally efficient description of collective light–matter dynamics, enabling precise benchmarking of numerical superradiance models.

title: An EVM-Cosmos Bridge for Atomic, Semantic-Preserving Transfer of Environmental Tokens
headline: Atomic, Semantic-Preserving Bridge Between EVM and Cosmos for Environmental Tokens
tldr: We introduce a deterministic bridge that preserves token semantics across EVM and Cosmos chains, preventing domain meaning loss. The design ensures atomic transfers despite differing consensus models, enabling reliable cross-chain environmental token trading.
significance: This bridge enables trustworthy, interoperable trading of carbon credits and other environmental assets across major blockchain ecosystems.

title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
headline: Assessing Whether Discrete Visual Tokens Can Truly Preserve Semantic Integrity
tldr: This paper investigates if discrete visual tokens can maintain semantic fidelity despite quantization errors. It compares token-based representations with continuous embeddings, revealing trade-offs for multimodal learning.
significance: Understanding token fidelity informs the design of future multimodal foundation models that integrate vision and language.

title: The Spatially-Resolved Recent Star Formation History of the M81 Disk
headline: Mapping Recent Star Formation Across M81's Disk Using Hubble ACS Photometry
tldr: We present a panoramic map of M81's stellar populations, revealing spatial variations in recent star formation over the entire disk. The study uses archival Hubble ACS data from the ANGST survey to trace star formation history on sub-kpc scales.
significance: This detailed map provides critical insight into how internal and tidal processes shape spiral galaxy evolution.

title: Optimal quantum discrimination at Liouvillian exceptional points
headline: Exceptional Points Offer No Advantage for Weak Perturbation Detection in Finite-Dimensional Lindblad Systems
tldr: While exceptional points enhance spectral response, they do not reduce the observation time needed to detect weak perturbations in Lindblad dynamics with a unique stationary state and nonzero relaxation gap. The study shows that EPs provide no fundamental advantage for reliable detection in such systems.
significance: The work clarifies the limits of non-Hermitian sensing, guiding future research toward more promising strategies for quantum detection.

title: When Should We Intervene at Test Time?
headline: When to Intervene at Test Time: Balancing Adaptation and Stability in AI Models
tldr: Test‑time adaptation can boost performance on corrupted data, but indiscriminate updates may harm subsequent batches. By leveraging target labels and batch statistics, models can learn when to adjust and when to stay fixed, improving robustness in real‑world deployments.
significance: Understanding the optimal timing for test‑time interventions is crucial for deploying reliable AI systems that adapt to changing data without compromising stability.

title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
headline: Heads of Security: Attention Gates Enhance LLM Prompt Injection Defense
tldr: Heads of Security (HoS) introduces learned per-head attention gates that enforce instruction-data separation, preventing prompt injection in large language models. Evaluated on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B, HoS improves robustness without sacrificing performance.
significance: HoS offers a lightweight, architecture-agnostic defense that strengthens LLM security while preserving inference speed.

title: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
headline: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Unifying Relations via Wilson Loops
tldr: This paper reinterprets attention mechanisms as a lattice gauge theory, where interactions between entities are mediated solely through Wilson loops. It demonstrates that allowing per-entity coordinate frames yields three key properties, offering a principled framework for relational reasoning.
significance: It provides a novel theoretical foundation linking attention to gauge invariance, potentially guiding the design of more robust relational models.

title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
headline: KPPax: Differentiable Kinetic ODE Preprocessor for Atmospheric ML
tldr: KPPax transforms traditional Kinetic PreProcessor outputs into differentiable, JAX-compatible code, enabling integration with machine-learning frameworks. It supports just-in-time compilation and vectorization for efficient atmospheric chemistry simulations.
significance: By bridging kinetic modeling and differentiable programming, KPPax accelerates the development of data-driven atmospheric chemistry models.

title: Mediated Interactions between Fermi Polarons in the Strongly Interacting Regime
headline: Exploring Strongly Interacting Fermi Polaron Mediated Interactions via Quantum Monte Carlo
tldr: Using zero-temperature quantum Monte Carlo, we characterize mediated interactions between Fermi polarons in a strongly correlated Fermi sea. The results uncover novel quasiparticle behavior that challenges conventional Landau Fermi-liquid predictions.
significance: This study provides the first quantitative description of mediated interactions in the strongly interacting regime, informing future experiments and theoretical models of quantum many-body systems.

title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
headline: Curated Learning Boosts Self-Improving Agents Using Large Language Models in Complex Environments
tldr: GEPA-Curator introduces a curated learning framework that filters out non-informative failures in multi-turn LLM agent rollouts. By focusing on prompt weaknesses and harness limitations, it improves agent performance more efficiently than traditional reflective optimizers.
significance: This approach streamlines self-improvement for LLM agents, reducing reliance on noisy feedback and accelerating deployment in real-world tasks.

title: GeoAI | Geo Week News
headline: AI Revolutionizes Geospatial Work: From Feature Extraction to Predictive Analysis
tldr: Artificial intelligence is transforming geospatial workflows by automating feature extraction and classifying point clouds. These advances enable predictive analysis across the data pipeline, unlocking new applications in imagery, LiDAR, and spatial datasets.
significance: GeoAI empowers faster, more accurate decision-making in fields ranging from urban planning to environmental monitoring.

title: 2025: GeoAI — GEOGRAPHY 2050
headline: Building GeoAI Foundation Models for Real-Time Global Change Detection and Forecasting
tldr: Foundation models trained on massive geospatial datasets can now interpret satellite imagery, LiDAR, and SAR to detect urban growth, crop health, and flood events in near real time. This capability enables policymakers and researchers to monitor and respond to environmental changes faster than ever before.
significance: Accurate GeoAI foundations transform raw Earth observations into actionable insights, accelerating climate resilience and sustainable development.

title: GeoAI and the Next Generation of Geospatial Insights - Geo Week News
headline: GeoAI Revolutionizes Geospatial Insights for Businesses and Governments in Urban Planning and Disaster Response
tldr: GeoAI blends geospatial data, sensing tech, and AI to deliver actionable insights. This shift empowers organizations to capture, analyze, and interpret spatial information faster and more accurately.
significance: By integrating AI with satellite imagery and sensor data, GeoAI unlocks new capabilities for real-time monitoring and decision-making across sectors.

title: Towards the next generation of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence
headline: Charting the Future of Geospatial AI: From Foundations to Real-World Impact
tldr: Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) merges geospatial science with AI, rapidly evolving as a leading research frontier. Understanding recent advances and forecasting future directions is essential for harnessing its transformative potential.
significance: GeoAI's integration of spatial data and machine learning promises breakthroughs across environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster response.

title: Top 5 Geospatial AI Trends to Watch in 2025 - arizton.com
headline: Top 5 GeoAI Trends to Watch in 2025: From Foundation Models to Real-Time Urban Insight
tldr: GeoAI is reshaping industries with AI-driven insights from satellite data to urban planning. In 2025, key trends include foundation models, real-time analytics, and advanced remote sensing.
significance: Understanding these trends is essential for stakeholders aiming to leverage AI for smarter, data-driven decision-making.

title: remote-sensing · GitHub Topics · GitHub
headline: Remote Sensing Change Detection Hub: Datasets, Tools, Methods, Reviews, and Competitions
tldr: This repository aggregates the latest datasets, tools, and research for detecting changes in remote sensing imagery. It also lists competitions and review papers to support practitioners and researchers.
significance: It serves as a central resource accelerating progress in automated change detection across environmental and urban monitoring.

title: GeoAI: Artificial Intelligence for Geospatial Data - GitHub
headline: GeoAI Toolkit: Streamlined Satellite Imagery Access and AI-ready Preprocessing for Machine Learning
tldr: GeoAI provides a unified interface to download, mosaic, and preprocess satellite imagery from Sentinel, Landsat, NAIP, and other open sources. It also automates training dataset creation, vector-raster conversions, and data augmentation for AI workflows.
significance: This toolkit accelerates AI research on geospatial data by simplifying data acquisition and preprocessing.

title: Home - GeoAI
headline: GeoAI: Bridging AI and Geospatial Analysis with an Open-Source Python Package
tldr: GeoAI is a powerful open-source Python library that seamlessly integrates machine learning with geospatial data analysis and visualization. It equips researchers and practitioners with intuitive tools for tasks ranging from remote sensing to spatial reasoning.
significance: By unifying AI and geospatial workflows, GeoAI accelerates insights across environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster response.

title: Open Source Software - The Geological Remote Sensing Group (GRSG)
headline: GRSG: Open-Source Remote Sensing Suite for Optical, SAR, and Hyperspectral Analysis
tldr: GRSG aggregates free geospatial tools for advanced remote sensing across optical, multispectral, SAR, and hyperspectral data, enabling researchers to perform sophisticated image processing. The platform supports a wide range of applications from urban analysis to environmental monitoring.
significance: By unifying powerful open-source libraries, GRSG democratizes access to cutting-edge remote sensing capabilities, accelerating scientific discovery and practical applications.

title: Raster Vision: An open-source machine learning library for deep ...
headline: Raster Vision: Open-Source GIS and Deep Learning Toolkit for Satellite Image Analysis
tldr: Raster Vision is an open-source library that unifies GIS and deep learning for remote sensing tasks. It offers a configurable pipeline for chip classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection on satellite imagery.
significance: It democratizes advanced computer vision for geospatial analysis, enabling researchers and practitioners to build robust models without reinventing the wheel.

title: geoai-py · PyPI
headline: GeoAI: A Python Toolkit for AI-Driven Geospatial Data Analysis and Remote Sensing
tldr: GeoAI is an open-source Python package that integrates AI and geospatial data analysis. It offers intuitive tools for applying machine learning techniques to geographic data, enabling researchers and practitioners to perform tasks such as segmentation, object detection, and time-series analysis.
significance: GeoAI democratizes advanced geospatial AI workflows, making sophisticated analysis accessible to a broad community.

title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
headline: DecisionRAG: Leveraging Language Models for Retrieval Without Traditional Indexes and Lexical Matching
tldr: DecisionRAG replaces lexical or embedding-based retrieval with decision models that guide pretrained language models to locate relevant documents. This approach eliminates retrieval bottlenecks, allowing generators to recover even when traditional retrievers miss key information.
significance: By freeing retrieval from lexical constraints, DecisionRAG enables more robust and flexible document navigation, improving the reliability of large language model outputs.

title: Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies
headline: Center-of-Mass View of Evolution Strategies: A Geometric Take on Optimization
tldr: Evolution strategies can be seen as moving the center of mass of a weighted particle cloud, where each perturbed model is a particle and its reward is its mass. This geometric view offers a fresh perspective on how ES updates the model parameters.
significance: This interpretation simplifies understanding of ES updates and may inspire new algorithmic variations.

title: Auto-Research Arena: Benchmarking and Advancing Auto-Research in Language Modeling
headline: Auto-Research Arena: A New Benchmark for Autonomous Language Model Research
tldr: The Auto-Research Arena introduces a multi-target benchmark that evaluates autonomous research systems in language modeling. It provides a shared experimental environment that separates admissibility criteria, enabling systematic discovery of novel ideas.
significance: This benchmark accelerates the development of self-driving research agents by offering a standardized, reproducible evaluation framework.

title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
headline: VibeVideoBench: Benchmarking Code-Driven Video Generation for Evaluating Multimodal Agents in Real-World Scenarios
tldr: Diffusion video models struggle to render precise formulas, charts, or synchronized narration, prompting a shift toward multimodal agents that generate code for each frame and sound. VibeVideoBench evaluates these agents with a 23‑task benchmark.
significance: This benchmark advances the evaluation of code-driven video generation, bridging the gap between visual fidelity and functional accuracy.

title: Complete entropy contraction from conditional hyperboundedness
headline: Conditional Hyperboundedness and GNS Contraction Yield Entropy Contraction in Quantum Channels
tldr: We prove that for finite-dimensional quantum channels compatible with a faithful conditional expectation, conditional hyperboundedness together with strict GNS contraction ensures a contraction of relative entropy. For KMS-symmetric quantum Markov semigroups, a conditional 2→q hyperboundedness at time t0 combined with a GNS spectral gap yields an explicit lower bound for the modified logarithmic Sobolev constant.
significance: This result bridges functional analytic properties of quantum channels with entropy decay, providing new tools for quantum information theory.

title: Do vision models know that three is three?
headline: Do Vision Models Truly Understand Conceptual Shifts Across Handwritten Digits and Everyday Scenes?
tldr: Vision models may encode transformations like 2→3 or clean→dirty as linear directions in their latent space, but do they generalize these changes across different modalities? This study probes whether such models truly grasp abstract concept changes or merely learn superficial patterns.
significance: Understanding whether vision models capture abstract transformations informs how we design more robust, transferable AI systems.

title: On the stability of learning
headline: Stability of Learning with Sparse, Noisy, Intermittent Gradient Signals in Neural Networks
tldr: This study investigates how learning algorithms behave when gradient information is sparse, local, and noisy, as often occurs in biological neural networks. The authors demonstrate that intermittent gradients can destabilize learning, highlighting the need for robust training methods under realistic signal constraints.
significance: Understanding the limits of learning under realistic, intermittent gradient conditions is crucial for designing resilient artificial and biological neural systems.

title: FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis
headline: FL4N: A Feed-Forward Latent Model for Real-Time 4D Novel View Synthesis
tldr: FL4N introduces a feed-forward latent representation for 4D novel view synthesis, eliminating the need for explicit 4D Gaussian models. It achieves temporally consistent, artifact-free rendering across viewpoints and timestamps in real time.
significance: This work enables efficient, temporally coherent dynamic scene rendering, advancing real-time 4D graphics.

title: Adequacy radii for stepped-wedge trials with time-varying effects
headline: Balancing Precision and Effect Estimation in Stepped-Wedge Trials with Time-Varying Effects
tldr: Stepped-wedge designs lack concurrent controls in final periods, creating tension between precise constant-effect analyses and exposure-time indicator methods that target time-averaged effects. This paper proposes adequacy radii to guide design choice under exposure-time heterogeneity.
significance: It offers a principled framework to balance precision and effect estimation in stepped-wedge trials, improving inference under time-varying interventions.

title: Differentiable Contact Dynamics for Legged Locomotion: Policy Learning and Contact-Implicit Trajectory Optimization
headline: Smooth Analytic Gradient for Frictional Contact Enables Real-Time Legged Locomotion Optimization
tldr: The authors derive a differentiable, smooth gradient for frictional contact that overcomes mode-switching limitations, enabling policy learning and contact-implicit trajectory optimization for legged robots. This approach provides closed-form sensitivities across contact transitions, improving stability and efficiency in locomotion planning.
significance: It advances legged robot control by delivering a tractable, mode-aware gradient that facilitates learning and optimization in complex contact scenarios.

title: The Language of Instruction: Genre and Generative AI
headline: Instruction-Fine-Tuned LLMs as a New Genre: The Instructional-Conversational Paradigm in AI
tldr: The article proposes that instruction-fine-tuned language models constitute a distinct genre—called the instructional‑conversational genre—formed by recursive interactions between humans and generative models. It argues that understanding these models as a genre clarifies their design, evaluation, and deployment across AI applications.
significance: Recognizing instruction‑fine‑tuned LLMs as a genre reshapes how we evaluate and deploy generative AI, emphasizing conversational dynamics over static performance metrics.

title: SEMAC: Spherical Energy Matching Ambisonics Codec for Efficient Higher-Order Ambisonics Compression
headline: SEMAC: A New Codec for Efficient Compression of Higher-Order Ambisonics Audio
tldr: SEMAC introduces a spherical energy matching approach that reduces bitrate growth in HOA by selectively encoding energy-per-spherical-harmonic rather than all channels. The codec achieves comparable audio quality to Opus while cutting channel count and enabling real‑time streaming of immersive audio.
significance: This codec addresses the quadratic bitrate challenge of HOA, making high‑order spatial audio more practical for streaming and real‑time applications.

title: Separating Thinking from Spelling for Efficient Generative Recommendation
headline: Optimizing Generative Recommender Efficiency by Decoupling Thinking from Spelling for Large-Scale Web Platforms
tldr: This work introduces a method to separate the reasoning process from the spelling of semantic IDs in generative recommenders, reducing the computational cost of beam search. By decoupling the two stages, the approach cuts the backbone passes from O(BK) to a more efficient schedule, enabling deployment at scale.
significance: The technique dramatically lowers inference latency and resource usage for large-scale recommendation systems, making generative recommenders practical for real-time web applications.

title: Fréchet Kriging for Metric Space-Valued Spatial Data
headline: Fréchet Kriging: Predicting Non-Euclidean Spatial Data in General Metric Spaces
tldr: We introduce Fréchet kriging, a general framework for spatial prediction of metric-space-valued data such as probability distributions and SPD matrices. The method extends classical kriging to non-Euclidean settings, enabling accurate interpolation without vector space assumptions.
significance: Fréchet kriging unlocks spatial analysis for a wide range of modern data types that were previously inaccessible to traditional geostatistics.

title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
headline: SceneBloom: Generating Realistic Indoor Layouts for Embodied AI Training
tldr: SceneBloom combines language guidance with diffusion-based visual generation to produce diverse, physically valid 3D indoor scenes. It bridges semantic planning and spatial reasoning, enabling more realistic embodied agent training.
significance: The method advances embodied AI by providing scalable, realistic environments that improve generalization and learning efficiency.

title: UniAction: Unified Action Conditioning for World Models
headline: Unified Action Conditioning for World Models
tldr: We propose UniAction, a framework that encodes any action as a sparse set of semantic elements, enabling a single action-conditioned world model to handle diverse action types. This unification reduces data fragmentation and improves model generalization across tasks.
significance: UniAction streamlines action-conditioned modeling, boosting efficiency and performance in dynamic environments.

title: FlexGlue: Sparse-to-Dense Feature Matching and Visual Disambiguation
headline: FlexGlue: Bridging Sparse and Dense Feature Matching for Robust Visual Disambiguation
tldr: FlexGlue unifies sparse interest points and dense pixel grids to estimate correspondences efficiently while rejecting visually symmetric mismatches. It introduces a hybrid matching pipeline that improves robustness and speed for image alignment tasks.
significance: It addresses the trade-off between efficiency and robustness in feature matching, enabling more reliable image correspondence in challenging visual scenarios.

title: Ideal interaction dynamics of defects and background fields in condensed matter
headline: Coupling Defect Dynamics with Background Fields: Modeling Interactions in Condensed Matter Systems
tldr: Defect tracking is common, but modeling their coupled evolution with background fields remains difficult. Understanding this interaction is crucial for predicting system behavior.
significance: Accurately capturing defect–field coupling can unlock new insights into material properties and guide the design of advanced functional materials.

title: Comprehensive Visible and Near-infrared Keck and Gemini Monitoring and Characterization of Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS during its Encounter with the Solar System
headline: Keck and Gemini Monitor Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS: Optical and Near‑IR Observations
tldr: We present 14 optical imaging and eight spectroscopic epochs of comet 3I/ATLAS from Keck and Gemini, along with near‑infrared imaging and spectroscopy, revealing its color properties and activity during its solar encounter. The data provide a comprehensive time‑series of its photometric and spectroscopic evolution, informing models of interstellar comet composition.
significance: These observations offer the first detailed multi‑wavelength characterization of an interstellar comet, enhancing our understanding of cometary origins beyond the Solar System.

title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
headline: RobustRLlib: Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
tldr: RobustRLlib provides an algorithm-centric framework that unifies existing robust RL methods and offers a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate their performance under diverse distribution shifts. By enabling easy reuse of algorithms and clarifying empirical limits, it accelerates research and deployment of reliable RL systems.
significance: This library lowers barriers to robust RL research, fostering reproducibility and practical deployment of resilient policies.

title: On the continuity of conditional distributions and stratification for derivative pricing
headline: Reducing Monte Carlo Variance in Derivative Pricing Through Stratified Sampling
tldr: Stratification partitions the sample space by a low-dimensional factor, reducing estimator variance in Monte Carlo simulations for path-dependent derivatives. The method's effectiveness hinges on selecting an appropriate stratification factor, which remains a critical challenge.
significance: This approach can dramatically improve pricing accuracy and computational efficiency for complex financial instruments.

title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
headline: DexPort: Hand‑Held Interface for Efficient Dexterous Manipulation Data Collection and Analysis
tldr: DexPort provides a portable, hand‑held interface that captures high‑quality dexterous hand motions, bypassing the need for full robot setups and complex retargeting. It streamlines data collection for learning manipulation by allowing operators to record natural hand gestures that can be directly mapped to robotic actions.
significance: DexPort bridges the gap between human demonstration and robotic execution, accelerating the acquisition of high‑quality dexterous manipulation datasets.

title: MiD-VLM: Detecting and Grounding Global Semantic Misinformation in Image-Caption Pairs
headline: MiD‑VLM: Detecting Global Semantic Misinformation in Image‑Caption Pairs Using Vision‑Language Models
tldr: MiD‑VLM introduces a vision‑language model that identifies mismatches between authentic images and misleading captions, grounding the source of misinformation. The system leverages a new DGM4+ dataset and demonstrates state‑of‑the‑art performance in detecting global semantic distortions.
significance: This work enables reliable detection of narrative manipulation in multimedia, a critical step toward trustworthy AI and media literacy.

title: Collapsed translating solitons with planar wings
headline: Collapsed Translating Solitons with Planar Wings Are Only Vertical Flat Planes
tldr: We prove that any complete embedded translating soliton in ℝ³ with finite genus, finite entropy, and planar-type wings must be a vertical flat plane. This settles a conjecture about the impossibility of gluing or doubling constructions involving planes.
significance: This result confirms that planar wings cannot support nontrivial collapsed translators, eliminating a class of potential counterexamples in mean curvature flow.

title: Boosted Dark Matter Directionality in Large Liquid Scintillator Detectors
headline: Detecting Boosted Dark Matter with Large Liquid Scintillator Detectors via Neutron Capture
tldr: Light dark matter can be accelerated by cosmic rays, enabling its detection in large neutrino detectors. By observing quasi‑elastic scattering off carbon and the delayed gamma from neutron capture, researchers can identify boosted dark matter events.
significance: This technique opens a new window for probing sub‑GeV dark matter that is otherwise invisible to conventional direct‑detection experiments.
